purpose: Frozen descriptive secondaries and unchanged affine fit conditioning; no new inferential tests

affine_conditioning.interpretation: Near-zero positive corrected variances are not clamped by the frozen rule. Large fitted scales make this secondary unstable; original result retained without tolerance changes or refitting.

readout_limit: Only recorded DAN/CX_DAN/central group totals; per-neuron group means are totals divided by census size, not invented individual traces.
